description: Supervisor runs whose baseline training started from a previous run's trained weights. A run installs its best model (trained weights) when it ends; until the 2026-11-25 fix, the next run of the same dataset reused an installed model of the baseline design unchanged, so its baseline_training was warm-started. Found by replaying every run's installed model in order (scripts/warm_start_audit.py). scope 'baseline': only that run's baseline value is invalid (every later training in the run replaced the model with a fresh seeded one). scope 'run': the run's keep-or-revert decisions compared against the inflated baseline, so the whole run is excluded and was re-run.
